Name: Fertilizer Anytime
Author: lefthandedkid
Description:
[b]COMPATIBLE WITH 1.5!
[/b] 
 
[b]Description[/b]

Fertilizer Anytime is a mod that allows you to apply all fertilizer types to plants that have already sprouted. This is particularly useful in the Greenhouse, where fertilizer is cleared at the end of the month.

Note if the produce is currently harvestable, you can't apply fertilizer at that point because it's too late. However, if the crop has multiple harvests, like beans, then you can apply the fertilizer right after harvesting.

In a multiplayer game, this mod only works for a player if they have it installed on their machine.

[b]Configuration[/b]

There are no configuration options available for this mod.
